task: Compare the iPhone 16 and Google Pixel 9 for a college student on a budget.

structured_output.summary: The iPhone 16 and the Google Pixel 9 offer impressive camera capabilities, battery life, and water resistance. Both devices also come with competitive pricing options for students. The main difference between them lies in their storage options and pricing.
structured_output.details: The iPhone 16 is available in three storage options: 64GB, 128GB, and 256GB. On the other hand, the Google Pixel 9 starts at 128GB. Additionally, both devices boast a quad-camera setup on the back with improved low-light performance. They also offer up to 3 days of use due to their long-lasting battery life. IP68 water resistance is another feature that they share among themselves. Notably, the iPhone 16 has an advantage in terms of pricing for college students compared to the Google Pixel 9. Specifically, the difference between the higher storage option and a payment plan starting at $849 for the Google Pixel 9 is $150 more than the iPhone 16's lower-end option.
structured_output.recommendation: To maximize cost-effectiveness while still taking advantage of excellent camera capabilities, consider purchasing the iPhone 16 with its available college student discount.

task: Plan a 3-day trip to Goa for two people who like beaches and seafood.

structured_output.summary: For a 3-day trip to Goa for two people interested in beaches and seafood, the estimated total cost is $2300. The best day pass for the beach in South Goa with pools and Ocean View Resort costs around $40 per person for the day. Accommodations can be booked at a budget-friendly ocean view resort, costing approximately $200 per night for a double room, and meals can be planned within a budget of $30 per meal for two people.
structured_output.details: The total cost of the trip to Goa can be broken down into several components: transportation (not included in this calculation), accommodations, food, and activities. To begin with, let's calculate the cost of accommodations for a double room at an ocean view resort in South Goa. This will be needed for 3 nights. Accommodation costs around $200 per night but since the calculator only gave us an exact number once it was given another input -- we will consider  $4000 / 2 which equals to 2400 as the total amount available. Therefore, the total amount needed will be slightly less than this with cost of food included ($30 x 6 meals=180). This leaves plenty of budget  for anything extra: like transportation: or activities on a day-by-day basis. The exact accommodation price can change over time and would be subject to seasonal discounts. Hence $200 per night, while the highest estimate possible on this trip should have less than $2400 to accommodate other unexpected expenses as well - it is wise to budget for some extra dollars just in case! For beaches in South Goa with private villas & pools, popular options include  The Leela, InterContinental, or Taj. For a beach experience without the need for these luxury properties - like Palolem Beach -- Sunbird or Sea Dragon resorts are great alternatives too. When booking your hotel, check reviews to see what activities and experiences they recommend -- their amenities can make all the difference whether you go full-on resort stay or just vacationing from the premises on a day-by-day basis when possible. Finally once everything has been booked - with money remaining if desired for the last bit of fun  we would then do some activity planning such as: snorkeling,  fishing (as both are budget-friendly with cost ranging between $20-$60 per person depending on service and type of fish. Snorkeling costs in Goa vary greatly but you can expect about 6000 - 10000 for equipment rental -- if looking to rent instead of bring along your own. In end we'd see if the day pass would be too expensive so with activities planned around both resort stay, daily activity & cost it should all come out well and fun for all!
structured_output.recommendation: To plan an affordable and enjoyable trip to Goa for two people interested in beaches and seafood, consider booking accommodations at a budget-friendly ocean view resort ($200 per night) and planning meals within a budget of $30 per meal. Be sure to research the best activities and day passes available to ensure that they fit within your daily budget.

task: Explain this Python bug: a recursive function that hits RecursionError on inputs larger than 900, and suggest a fix.

structured_output.summary: Python's default recursion limit is 1000, which may cause a RecursionError on inputs larger than this value. To avoid this error, consider rewriting recursive functions using iterative approaches, such as loops.
structured_output.details: The recursion limit can be increased by setting the recursion limit with sys.setrecursionlimit(). However, increasing the default limit is generally not recommended due to potential stack overflow issues. Instead, using iterative approaches can help prevent RecursionError and improve performance for large input values.
structured_output.recommendation: When rewriting recursive functions, consider replacing them with iterative loops to avoid RecursionError and take advantage of improved performance for large input values.
